source_statement: The source of this contract is reference documentation, not a published specification. VCF Automation has no OpenAPI/Swagger document in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository, so every path, field name, requiredness flag and default recorded below was transcribed by hand from the human-readable VCF Automation xAPIs reference pages at developer.broadcom.com. Each page URL, the operation it backs and the date it was fetched are recorded in docs/official_sources.json. Anything not present on those pages is marked as a local convention below and is binding only on this project.

wire_rules.rule: A request body carries a key only when the caller has a value for it. An optional field the caller did not set is omitted from the JSON object entirely; it is never sent as "", as null, or as a placeholder. The reference documents these fields as optional with no documented default, so an empty value is a distinct assertion rather than an absence and must not be invented by the client.
A request body carries no key that this contract does not name for that operation, and a query string carries no parameter this contract does not name for that operation.
One access token is obtained before the first Deployment API call and then reused. A new token is requested only after the service has rejected a request with 401, never speculatively per call.
Pagination stops as soon as the envelope reports that the current page is the last one. No request is made for a page index beyond the last page.

When a request fails with 401 the client refreshes the access token and replays exactly that one request. Work already completed is kept: pagination resumes at the page that was rejected and earlier pages are not re-fetched.

operations.summary: Exchange a refresh token for an access token.
operations.documentation_notes: The reference marks this operation deprecated in favour of /oidc/oauth2/token, but /oidc/oauth2/token has no operation page in the 9.1 xAPIs reference and therefore has no documented request or response schema to transcribe. This operation is the token exchange that the reference publishes a full schema for, so it is the one this contract pins.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.note: required in practice for the refresh_token grant

operations.summary: Fetch a paginated list of deployments.

query_parameters.name: size
query_parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned.

query_parameters.name: sort
query_parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc).

401.description: Unauthorized. The access token is missing, invalid or expired.
